title: Three dead in Los Angeles after driver crashes into pedestrians, officials say
description:
Three others critically injured and taken to hospitals as reports say car crashed into food stand in North Hollywood

A vehicle plowed into a group of pedestrians ⁠in the ⁠North ​Hollywood district of Los Angeles on Tuesday, ⁠killing three people and leaving at least three others ⁠critically injured, the city ​fire department reported.

The ‌three injured ‌people were taken to ‌area hospitals for treatment, according to an online statement posted by the Los Angeles fire department.

Continue reading...
text: At least three people are dead and three critically injured, after a car struck pedestrians on a Los Angeles corner during Tuesday rush hour, authorities said.
The fatal accident took place near a North Hollywood metro station.
The driver, whose identity remains unknown, is hospitalized in critical condition, according to Los Angeles police.
The fire and police department did not offer additional details on the deadly crash. An investigation remains under way.
